source_policy: Same complete pointed Hebrew in both units; no source or morphological analysis change, no historical-priority vote
scope: Honor/reputation idiom only; preserve paired lexical order reversal between19and20. All surrounding shared wording, including shame's relative-clause expansion, geography, gathering-time and fortunes, is not newly certified.

targets.source_text: הִנְ/נִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֛ה אֶת כָּל מְעַנַּ֖יִ/ךְ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֑יא וְ/הוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶת הַ/צֹּלֵעָ֗ה וְ/הַ/נִּדָּחָה֙ אֲקַבֵּ֔ץ וְ/שַׂמְתִּי/ם֙ לִ/תְהִלָּ֣ה וּ/לְ/שֵׁ֔ם בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בָּשְׁתָּֽ/ם־־־־׃
targets.close_gloss: ... I-will-set-them / for-praise / and-for-name / in-all / the-earth / their-shame.

candidates.text: Behold, at that time I will deal with all your oppressors, and I will save the lame and gather the outcast, and I will make them a praise and a name in every land where they were put to shame.
Behold, at that time I will deal with all your oppressors, and I will save the lame and gather the outcast, and I will make them praised and renowned in every land where they were put to shame.

candidates.text: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will make you a name and a praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says Yahweh.

At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will make you renowned and praised among all the peoples of the earth, when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says Yahweh.

lexical_controls.observation: Figurative praise/renown as object of praise/possessor of renown; explicit Zephaniah3:19,20

lexical_limit: Actual root whole-page memory scan inspection; public OCR unproofread; no fresh HALOT. Lexicon supports semantic range, not exclusive wording preference.
rubric: Source meaning and unsupported additions before fluency
Compare preservation of noun/name imagery with explicit public honor sense
Preserve pair order reversal; document grammatical nouns versus English predicate adjectives
Assess whether praised entails active acclaim beyond the Hebrew object-of-praise idiom
Paragraph context and readability; no theology veto or familiarity override
Allow current, proposed, tie or hold independently for each unit and as coherent pair
acceptance: One identity-masked assessment, same-reviewer reverse-order diagnostic not new vote; tie retains current; no unique-optimum or broad-corpus claim
first_exposure_order: Q,T; reverse order not fresh randomized exposure

context.source_text: רָנִּי֙ בַּת צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֖יעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל שִׂמְחִ֤י וְ/עָלְזִי֙ בְּ/כָל לֵ֔ב בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם־־׃
context.text: Sing for joy[a], daughter Zion; shout aloud, Israel! Rejoice and exult with all your heart, daughter Jerusalem!

context.source_text: הֵסִ֤יר יְהוָה֙ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔יִ/ךְ פִּנָּ֖ה אֹֽיְבֵ֑/ךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל יְהוָה֙ בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֔/ךְ לֹא תִֽירְאִ֥י רָ֖ע עֽוֹד׀־׃
context.text: Yahweh has taken away your judgments[a]; he has turned away your enemy. The King of Israel, Yahweh, is in your midst[b]; you will fear evil no more.

context.source_text: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא יֵאָמֵ֥ר לִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אַל תִּירָ֑אִי צִיּ֖וֹן אַל יִרְפּ֥וּ יָדָֽיִ/ךְ־־׃
context.text: On that day it will be said to Jerusalem[a], “Do not fear”; to Zion, “Do not let your hands grow weak.”

context.source_text: יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛יִ/ךְ בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֖/ך גִּבּ֣וֹר יוֹשִׁ֑יעַ יָשִׂ֨ישׂ עָלַ֜יִ/ךְ בְּ/שִׂמְחָ֗ה יַחֲרִישׁ֙ בְּ/אַ֣הֲבָת֔/וֹ יָגִ֥יל עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ בְּ/רִנָּֽה׃
context.text: Yahweh your God is in your midst, a mighty one who saves; he will rejoice over you with gladness; he will be quiet in his love[a][b]; he will exult over you with singing.

context.source_text: נוּגֵ֧י מִ/מּוֹעֵ֛ד אָסַ֖פְתִּי מִמֵּ֣/ךְ הָי֑וּ מַשְׂאֵ֥ת עָלֶ֖י/הָ חֶרְפָּֽה׃
context.text: I have gathered[b] those grieving over the appointed festival[a]—they were from you; reproach was a burden upon her[c][d][e].
